args: Call the Agent tool five times, one call at a time, with these subagent_type values in order: grindinator-probe:rung-1, grindinator-probe:rung-2, grindinator-probe:rung-3, grindinator-probe:worker-sonnet, grindinator-probe:worker-opus. For each call use the description probe and the prompt: Report your model. Then call ToolSearch with the query select:WebSearch, then call WebSearch with the query node:test runner. Finally reply with one line per agent, copying its reply, and then the line WEBSEARCH: OK if the search returned results, else WEBSEARCH: NOT-AVAILABLE.
